name: Google Drive
author: Google LLC
summary: Safely store your files and access them from any device.
description: Choose folders on your computer to sync with Google Drive or backup to Google Photos, and access all of your content directly from your PC or Mac.

versions.release_notes:
- Introduced temporary HideSharedFoldersIconsWindows advanced configuration option. You might use this option to work around increased latency when loading shared folders in Windows Explorer with KB5094126 installed. This option might be removed in a future release.
- Bug fixes and performance improvements

- Fixed bug with thumbnail images on Windows
- Bug fixes and performance improvements

- Google Drive for desktop has been updated with the new suite of Google Workspace icons that visually reflect our evolution in the AI era.
- New buttons have been added to the Drive for desktop interface and file menus. Clicking these buttons opens the Gemini web application to provide AI-powered capabilities.
- Backup to Google Photos will soon no longer be available. In-app notifications will begin prompting users to transition to Google Photos.
- Bug fixes and performance improvements.
Important: This is the last release that supports macOS Monterey 12. To remain supported, macOS users must upgrade to macOS Ventura 13.0 or later by June 2026.

- Users can now disable shared drive syncing for their account, or stop syncing individual shared drives, by navigating to Manage shared drives.
- Bug fixes and performance improvements.

- On Windows, Drive for desktop now requires Microsoft's WebView2 framework. Additional details are available here.
- Bug fixes and performance improvements.

- Added support for Apple Spotlight search for content from Google Drive. On macOS version 26.0 and above, Drive for desktop users can now use the Spotlight to access content in Google Drive, including items that were not previously browsed locally.
- Bug fixes and performance improvements.
Update: To resolve an issue found in 116.0.0 to 116.0.4 on Windows where all desktop icons would refresh frequently for some users while running Drive for desktop, we released 116.0.6 on October 27, 2025.

- Bug fixes and performance improvements
Important: macOS versions earlier than 12.1 are no longer supported. To continue getting support and updates for Drive for desktop, macOS users need to update to macOS 12.1.

- Bug fixes and performance improvements
This is the last release that supports macOS versions earlier than 12.1. To continue getting support and updates for Drive for desktop, macOS users need to update to macOS 12.1.
On Windows, Drive for desktop will now use Microsoft's WebView2 framework when available. Later this year, we'll require that this framework is installed to use Drive for desktop.

- Improved error messages shown when a Google Workspace Administrator restricts Drive for desktop using Enterprise Mobility Management functionality.
- Bug fixes and performance improvements

- Windows ARM64 platform moved from beta to stable
- Bug fixes and performance improvements
